_what: The error count this branch is allowed to carry. tools/validate_cards.py reports 1029 errors today; making that BLOCKING would paint every branch red permanently, and a permanently red CI is how this repo learned to ignore CI. So the gate is a RATCHET instead: the backlog may shrink, never grow. The ratchet reads its pass mark from the BASE branch, never from the branch it is judging, and refuses to compare a run that saw less than this one did.
_how_to_update: When the count goes DOWN, run `python3 tools/validate_cards.py --quiet --json /tmp/r.json` and commit the new number here in the same PR that lowered it. Never raise it to make a red build green — that is the grandfathering this validator exists to refuse.
_why: kredme-data is PUBLIC and KredMe-main is PRIVATE, so CI here can never check the app out. This baseline is therefore measured the way CI measures it: against the vendored tools/app_mirror/ category list. With a real app checkout the count is the same 610 — the mirror is current — but the run is DEGRADED either way and says so.
_why_this_number_rose: IT ROSE, DELIBERATELY: 613 -> 1029. 278 new cards were added from SaveSage (savesage.club, data extracted 13 Sep 2026) on the founder's instruction of 17 Sep 2026: "push everything (savesage minus kredme) to kredme-data dev branch. where there is discrepancy give preference to savesage." The 388 existing cards are untouched. The rise is what SaveSage does not publish, not format errors. By code: L4.MILESTONE_RATE_ABSURD 2->12; L4.POINT_VALUE_MISSING 46->261; L4.ZERO_BASE_RATE 60->81; L6.CHANNEL_NEVER_MATCHES 75->107; L6.EXCLUSION_TYPE_INERT 215->337; L6.INACTIVE_CARD_STILL_RANKS 24->25; L7.CARD_HAS_NO_RULES 28->42; L8.QUOTE_DOES_NOT_SUPPORT_RATE 12->13. L4.POINT_VALUE_MISSING: SaveSage publishes no rupee value per point, and a value read off its return range was inconsistent on most cards (it put RBL points at Rs 1.50), so it is left empty on 215 new cards. L6.EXCLUSION_TYPE_INERT: every exclusion SaveSage lists is written, including ones the engine cannot read (EMI, UPI, charity, gaming). L6.CHANNEL_NEVER_MATCHES: international-spend rates written the same way as the 75 already in the file. L4.ZERO_BASE_RATE / L7.CARD_HAS_NO_RULES: 14 new cards have no earn data on SaveSage at all. L4.MILESTONE_RATE_ABSURD: welcome bonuses SaveSage lists against a small first spend (RBL, Bandhan), stored as listed.
